card.title: Secure the Endorsement
card.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign here to say you support the extension.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then your support has no address when objections arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if we print the key beside them.

mechanism: A seeks an attributable signature so support for an extension survives public objections.
confusable: Unlike wanting agreement alone, A must reject anonymity that prevents using the endorsement as protection.
comparison: D52-b permits initials only with a printed key; D52-a permits email only with relevant critics copied.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
